title: Jesus I Am Resting, Resting
lyrics_original: In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
Thou hast bid me gaze upon Thee,
And Thy beauty fills my soul,
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
O, how great Thy loving kindness,
Yes, I rest in Thee, Belovèd,
Know what wealth of grace is Thine,
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
I behold Thee as Thou art,
And Thy love, so pure, so changeless,
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness
Ever lift Thy face upon me
As I work and wait for Thee;
In the joy of what Thou art;
I am finding out the greatness

bible_verses.english: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
But we all, with unveiled face beholding as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.
Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for inviting me to find true rest in Your presence today. Forgive me for the times I try to carry my burdens alone instead of fixing my gaze on You. Fill my soul with Your beauty and let Your transforming power make me whole. Teach me to abide peacefully in Your grace and find my joy in who You are. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: True rest is not found in changing our circumstances, but in beholding the beauty of Jesus. When we stop striving and simply fix our eyes on His loving heart, His presence begins to transform us from the inside out. He invites us to lay down our weariness and find our satisfaction in the joy of who He is. As you worship today, allow your soul to quiet down and rest securely in His unfailing love.
